2608.05867.title: Improving Interoperability among Defence and National Security Ontologies: Analysis and Evaluation Tasks
2608.05867.paper_summary: The use of ontologies and knowledge graphs is becoming increasingly widespread in the defence and national security domain. Numerous ontologies have been developed through initiatives led by academia, industry, and government. Achieving interoperability across diverse defence and national security ontologies remains a major challenge due to the domain's breadth and specialisation. In this work, we analyse and document over 60 publicly available ontologies and introduce a new track for the Ontology Alignment Evaluation Initiative (OAEI). This track comprises eight matching tasks, consensus alignments and manually-curated (silver-standard) mappings. The consensus alignments are derived by aggregating the outputs of several state-of-the-art ontology alignment systems. The silver-standard is obtained from the manual validation of the consensus alignment together with a subset of the unique mappings (i.e., mappings suggested by only one system).
2608.05867.paper_summary_zh: 在國防和國家安全領域，使用本體和知識圖譜的情況越來越普遍。許多本體是通過學術界、產業和政府主導的倡議開發的。由於該領域的廣度和專業化，實現不同國防和國家安全本體之間的互操作性仍然是一個主要挑戰。在這項工作中，我們分析並記錄了60多個公開可用的本體，並為本體對齊評估倡議（OAEI）引入了一個新的軌道。這個軌道包含八個匹配任務、共識對齊和手動策劃的（銀標準）映射。共識對齊是通過聚合幾個最先進的本體對齊系統的輸出來獲得的。銀標準是通過對共識對齊的手動驗證以及一組獨特映射（即僅由一個系統建議的映射）來獲得的。
